That evening he climbed the stairs earlier than usual, polished the lens until it shone, and lit the lamp for a man he had never met.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市仍在沉睡。路灯在空荡的街口投下昏黄的光，红绿灯独自变换着颜色，没有一辆车为它停下。远处传来清洁车缓慢的轰鸣，水雾在地面上留下一道湿亮的痕迹。早点铺的卷帘门刚刚拉起，蒸笼里冒出第一缕白气，混着面粉和豆浆的香味飘向街角。高楼的窗户大多黑着，只有零星几盏灯亮着。天边还是深蓝色，而新的一天已经悄悄开始。", "w03": "- Recursion is when you solve a job by doing a smaller copy of the same job.\n- Think of Russian nesting dolls: open one and there is a smaller doll inside, again and again.\n- The tiniest doll does not open, and that is the stopping point, so the process ends instead of going on forever."}
